paite: Huan i kihei ua, TOUPA'N i kiang ua agen bang in Tuipi San lam ah gamdai ah i lutta ua; Seir tang ni tampi i vel uhi.
TOUPA'N ahon houpih a,
"Hiai tang na vel sawt hunta uh. Mallam zuan in kihei un.
Mipite, Seir tang a om, Esau suan na unaute uh gam ah na paisuak ding uhi. Amau hon na lau ding ua; huaiziak in pilvang mahmah un.
Kisualpih kei un. Agam uh koi lai mah leng, khepek a sik khop lel leng nou ka hon pe kei ding. Seir tang zaw ama a tuam ding in Esau ka pe khinta hi.
Na nek ding un a-an uh sum in na lei ding ua, na dawn ding un atui uh leng sum in na lei ding uhi.

TOUPA na Pathian un na khut nasep peuhmah uah ahon vualzawl zel a, hiai gamdai zapi na totsuakdante uh leng athei hi. Hiai kum sawmli sung teng in TOUPA na kiang uah a-om a, bangmah na tasam kei uh, chi in thu pia in," achi hi.
Huchi in Elath leh Ezion-geber a pan Arabah lam a pai in Seir tang a om Esau suan i unaute gam i tawn paisuak uhi. I kihei ua, Moab gamdai lam ah i pai uhi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Moabte hihbuai kei unla, galsual in leng sual kei un. Agam uh nou a tuam ding in ka hon pe kei ding, Lot suante a tuam ding in Ar ka pe khinta hi,” achi hi.
Tuma lam in Emimte, huai ah ateng ua, amaute Anakte bang a milian leh tam, mi sangpite ahi uh.
Huaite leng Anakte mah bang a miliante ahi ua, himahleh Maobte'n Emimte achi uhi.
Tuma lam in Seir tang ah Horte leng a-om ua; himahleh Esau suante'n aluahsak uhi. Athat ua, amun uah atengta ua; Israelte TOUPA'N amau a tuam dia apiak gam mah bang in.
Huchi in "Thou unla, Zered Phaizang kan dih ua," achi a; huchi in Zered Phaizang i kanta uhi.
Kadesh-barnea a pan i pawt a, Zered Phaizang i kan ua, TOUPA'N akiang ua akichiam bang a mipi lak a misuan a gal dou thei mi tengteng abei vek kikal uh kum sawmthum-le-giat ahi.
Mipite lak a pan abei sipsip ma uh amaute hihmang ding in atung uah TOUPA khut atu hi.
Huchi ahi a, huchibang a mipi lak a pan galdou thei tengteng abei ua, ahong sih khit nung un,
TOUPA'N ahon houpih hi.
"Tuni in Moab gam, Ar na khen paisuak ding uh ahi.
Ammon suante kiang ava tun chiang un, hihbuai kei unla, kisualpih kei un. Ammonte gam nang a tuam ding in ka hon pe kei ding. Lot suante a tuam ding in ka pe khinta," achi hi.
Huai leng Rephaimte gam bang a sim ahi sam; huai ah tuma lam in Rephaimte ateng uhi. Himahleh Ammonte'n zaw Zamzummim achi uhi.
Anakte bang a milian leh tam leh misang pipi ahi ua; himahleh TOUPA'N ahihmang a, amau aluah leuleu ua, amun uah atengta uhi.
Seir tang a om Esau suante Horte ahihmansak lai a, ahih bang in; huchi in amau aluah ua, amun uah tu dong in ateng lai uhi.
Gaza tan a khoneu chikchik a om Avvite Kaphtor a pan a hong pawt Kaphtorte'n ahihmang ua, amun uah ateng uhi.
"Thou unla, paikhia unla, Arnon Phaizang kan un; ngai dih ua, Amor mi Heshbon kumpipa Sihon leh agam ka hon pe khinta hi; luah peuhmah unla, galsual in sual un.
Tuni in, van nuai a mite tung ah nang hon lauhna uh leh hon kihtakna uh ka omsak pan dia, na tanchin aza ding ua, aling ding ua nang ziak in gimthuak in a-om ding uhi," achi hi.
Kedemoth gamdai a pan Heshbon kumpipa Sihon kiang ah lemna thu pua in mi ka sawl hi.
heading: Israel In Kumpipa Sihon Azou / (Nam 21.21-30)

paite: "Na gam ah hon paisuaksak dih ve. Lamlian zel ah ka pai ding ua, ataklam ah hiam, aveilam ah hiam leng ka pial kei ding uh.
Ka nek ding un an sum in na hon leisak dia, ka dawn ding un tui leng sum mah in na hon leisak ding hi.
Jordan ka kan ua TOUPA ka Pathian un ahon piak gam ka lut masiah uh, Seir a om Esau suante leh Ar a om Moabte'n ahon paisuaksak bang un hon paisuaksak lel in," chi in.
Himahleh Heshbon kumpipa Sihon in agam ah hon paisuaksak nuam kei a; TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ua ahon piaktheihna ding in alungtang akhauhsak a, na theihsa uh bang un apaupengsak hi.
TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Ngai in, Sihon leh agam hon pe ding ka hita, agam tang ding in luah peuhmah in," ahon chi hi.
Sihon leh ami tengteng Jahaz a hong sual ding in ahong kuan uh.
TOUPA i Pathian in ahon pia a; amah leh atate leh amite tengteng i that uhi.
Huai lai in akhua tengteng i la ua, huai khuate a mihing tengteng, numei leh ataneu chikchikte uh tan in i hihmang vek ua, hawi mahmah i nei kei uhi.
I lak khua a gallak a i lak thil leh gante kia ei a tuam ding in i la uhi.
Arnon Phaizang a om Aroer a pan leh phaizang a kho omte a pan Gilead pha in ei a ding in khua sang lua a-om kei hi, TOUPA i Pathian in hon pe vek hi.
TOUPA'N thu hon piak bang in Ammon suante gam koimah, Jabok lui tan in mual tung a khuate kim leh kiang gam hitaleh na naih kei uhi.
